_readme: Zamówienia do Meshy (text-to-3D). Workflow „Meshy → repo” tworzy zadania, czeka na wynik i zapisuje render (PNG) oraz model (GLB) do public/assets/meshy/<id>/. Klucz API: sekret repozytorium MESHY_API_KEY.

requests.prompt: Marble bust sculpture of a theatre director with a laurel wreath, classical Greek style, weathered white marble, on a simple square plinth, gold accents, museum statue
Minimalist white marble bust sculpture of a teacher holding a small open book, smooth simple forms, on a plain plinth, museum statue
Art deco bronze bust sculpture of an entrepreneur with geometric brass ornaments, dark teal patina, on a stepped plinth, museum statue
Ornate gold wall sconce torch holder with a small flame, palace interior, baroque style
